svg.title: Step 7 mockup 05: Organiser: the sessions, and a new session (organiser)
svg.text: 05 · Organiser: the sessions, and a new session (organiser)
Use case: an organiser plans the tournament's sessions for the weekend and adds one; sessions are a card grid (amendment 3)

g.text: Demo Game Cup · the weekend's sessions, standings and final.
6 sessions · 1 open · 1 running · 2 done · 312 players registered

svg.text: New session · a form page (40 rem)

g.text: Rounds of 4 players; the top 2 go on
Or: one match with everyone (the default)
Adds a run-of-show item (the agenda's mirror, built).

svg.text: Sessions are one auto-fill grid per day (card size), with the crew band above: amendment 3.
A card shows 4 lines at most, then '+n more'; the session's state pill leads.
Copy from the last event uses the tenants clone (same series), shifting the times (O9).
The format is one of three shapes; points, check-in and close come from the event's settings (D2, O3).
Matches are an option: one match for everyone, or rounds that 'winners advance' fills (P4).
Adding a session emits tournament.session.added; the agenda adds its item (built).
